en.topic_title: Hong Kong installs HK$5m ‘anti-terrorism’ crash bollards outside Causeway Bay mall
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong authorities have installed “anti-terrorism” collision bollards outside a shopping mall in Causeway Bay, one of the city’s busiest shopping districts – a project with a HK$5 million price tag.



“Anti-terrorism” traffic bollards in Causeway Bay on November 6, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The bollards, which were still wrapped in foam sheeting on Thursday morning, were initially proposed in January by the police, the Transport Department, and the Highways Department
